Test Objective: Login succeeds with valid admin account
Pre-condition: Application is running locally and seeded admin account exists.
Steps Executed: 1 Open /Admin/Auth/Login | 2 Enter admin email | 3 Enter valid password | 4 Click Sign in.
Expected Result: User is redirected to the admin area dashboard; authenticated session is established; no validation error is shown.
Actual Result: Valid admin login reached the admin dashboard successfully in the focused Selenium rerun.

Test Objective: Product import preview shows valid and invalid row counts for prepared workbook
Pre-condition: Warehouse or admin user is logged in and a prepared xlsx file with mixed valid and invalid rows exists.
Steps Executed: 1 Log in as warehouse or admin | 2 Open /Admin/Products/ImportExcel | 3 Upload the prepared xlsx file | 4 Submit preview.
Expected Result: Preview page opens successfully; total rows, valid rows, invalid rows, and row-level errors are displayed.
Actual Result: The mixed-validation workbook uploaded successfully and the preview page displayed 6 total rows, 1 valid row, and 5 invalid rows.

Test Objective: Health endpoint returns service availability metadata
Steps Executed: 1 Ensure the application is running locally | 2 Send GET request to http://localhost:5068/api/v1/health using Postman or browser.
Expected Result: JSON response contains non-empty fields for status, service, serverTimeUtc, and version; status value is ok.
Actual Result: Health endpoint returned 200 OK and all Newman assertions for status, service, serverTimeUtc, and version passed in the full collection rerun.

Test Objective: Create invoice successfully for walk-in sale with unpaid status
Pre-condition: Sales or admin user is logged in; at least one active product has stock greater than 0.
Steps Executed: 1 Log in as sales or admin | 2 Open /Admin/Invoices/Create | 3 Leave customer empty for walk-in sale or choose a valid customer | 4 Select one active in-stock product
Expected Result: Invoice is created successfully; details page is shown; invoice status is Unpaid; stock is reduced by the sold quantity.
Actual Result: Submitting a valid walk-in invoice returned to the Create page with the toast message Failed to create invoice. Please check data and try again. Server log confirms InvalidOperationException caused by a user-initiated transaction with MySqlRetryingExecutionStrategy in InvoicesController.Create line 145.
